title: The Quarry Face
text: A cliff of fine dressed stone rises from the hillside, half quarried long ago and left. The tools still lie rusted where they fell, as if the workers set them down mid-blow and walked away. Nobody knows why they stopped.

options.label: Everyone takes up a rusted tool and cuts where the workers left off.

outcomes.text: You cut a great deal of good stone, and every arm aches to the shoulder.
The face gives way, as it did for the last workers.

options.label: The sharpest finds the best seam, so you cut little and cut well.

outcomes.text: The stone is little but the finest, with a few old coins in the rubble.

options.label: Take the abandoned tools; iron is iron, whoever dropped it.

outcomes.text: They are rusted but good. You try not to wonder why they were dropped.
